You will have a day full of history and peaceful reflection. Are you coming? We are waiting for you!

Title: Private Guided Tour to Miyajima from Osaka or Kyoto
Description:
Come with us to visit the Shinto Itsukushima-jinja Shrine for half a day!

We will leave Osaka or Kyoto to visit Miyajima Island, famous for its Shinto shrine Itsukushima and for its torii, emblematic shinto gate inside the sea. Let’s feel together the calm and serenity of the place, with its free-ranging Shika deer and abundant surrounding nature.

During this half-day tour, accompanied by your expert guide in Japanese history, you will discover the medieval and religious History of Japan.You will have a day rich in history, reflection and nature. Are you coming? We are waiting for you!

Title: Half-Day Private Guided Tour to Mount Ikoma
Description:
Come with us to visit Mount Ikoma for half a day on foot and by public transport.

The culture, history and natural beauty of Japan will be there for your great pleasure!

We take the cute Ikoma Cable Car to reach the top of Mount Ikoma. First, we walk and visit Monzenmachi, a charming neighborhood leading to Hozanji Temple. We discover this area, from the 7th Century and this ancient temple from the 17th century, dedicated to Ganesh

We finish with Ikoma Skyland, an amusement park with breathtaking views of Osaka Bay and Nara’s bowl. These views are particularly magical at sunset.

After this half day, you will learn more about the history of Japan. You will also have had plenty in your eyes with the landscapes and panoramic views throughout the visit. Are you coming? We are waiting for you!

Title: 3-Hour Private Guided Tour to Lake Biwa from Kyoto
Description:
Come with us to enjoy a half-day discovery tour of Lake Biwa, Japan's largest lake, departing from Kyoto Station. Aboard the Michigan Cruise, admire the picturesque scenery as you cruise the calm waters of Lake Biwa for an hour and a half. Explore the charming town of Otsu and be captivated by the region's natural beauty. This tour is perfect for nature and culture lovers, offering a relaxing and scenic experience.

- Departure from Kyoto Station for Lake Biwa
- 1.5-hour cruise aboard the Michigan Cruise
- Discover the town of Otsu and its landscapes
- Ideal for nature and culture lovers

Are you coming? We're waiting for you!

Title: Half-Day Private Guided Tour to Chikubushima, from Kyoto
Description:
Come discover Chikubushima Island, on Lake Biwa, on this four-hour walking and public transport tour!

Meet us at Kyoto Station, and off we go! Head to Imazu Port on the shores of Lake Biwa. Lake Biwa is the largest lake in Japan and the third oldest in the world. You'll be able to admire this monumental testament to the planet's geological age.

Then take the ferry to Chikubushima, an island in the middle of the lake. Lush flora and fauna welcome you. It's perfect for nature lovers! Then head deeper into this small island to visit the Hogon-ji Buddhist temple and the Itsukusuma Shinto shrine. You'll learn more about Japan's religious and medieval history.
